log.text: Light Screen up on P1's side
Gholdengo used Make It Rain → Primarina

decisions.rationale: Lead Grimm+Altaria: Prankster Fake Out/screens + Cloud Nine blanks Sand Rush/chip and sets Tailwind. Back Gengar (Mega trap Ttar/Floette/Gholdengo) + Primarina (Liquid Voice HV/Moonblast/Ice Beam into sand core/Rotom/Sinistcha).
decisions.notebook: Matchup build: Opp sand (Ttar+Excadrill), Mega Floette, Gholdengo, bulky specials (Rotom-H/Sinistcha). Cloud Nine Altaria blanks Sand Rush/chip + Tailwind/WoW; Mega Gengar traps/deletes Ttar/Floette/Gholdengo after Grimm Light Clay screens+Fake Out. Annihilape RF/CC + Liquid Voice Primarina HV/Moonblast pressure Rock/Dark/Steel; Hyper Cutter Gliscor EQ pivots into Gholdengo (Rotom Levitates). Registered sets unchanged. Game1 bring: Grimm/Altaria/Gengar/Primarina.

decisions.rationale: Bring Tyranitar/Floette lead with Excadrill/Gholdengo back. Tyranitar sets sand (arming Sand Rush Excadrill to outspeed and OHKO Mega Gengar with Soft Sand High Horsepower) and Chople cushions Close Combat/Focus Blast. Mega Floette is fast and blows up Grimmsnarl, Annihilape, Gliscor and especially Altaria, whose Cloud Nine is their sand answer. Gholdengo is Ghost so Shadow Tag can't trap it, Good as Gold blanks Will-O-Wisp/Parting Shot, it's Fighting-immune vs Annihilape and Make It Rain is SE
decisions.notebook:
Series build/plan (durable):
My sets: Excadrill @SoftSand SandRush Adamant 205Atk/130Spe (520 in sand) HighHorsepower/IronHead/RockSlide/Protect | Tyranitar @Chople SandStream 202Atk/130Def/132SpD/81Spe RockSlide/Crunch/IceBeam/Protect | Gholdengo @LifeOrb GoodAsGold 203SpA/110Spe, HP 163 | Floette-Eternal @Floettite (Mega: FairyAura, base 85/87/155/148/102; ~137-140 Spe after Mega) | Rotom-Heat @Charcoal Levitate 166SpA/122Spe | Sinistcha @Sitrus Hospitality RagePowder redirect.
Foe key facts: Mega Gengar (ShadowTag, raw Spe 165-200) outspeeds everything of mine except Excadrill in sand (260). Excadrill SoftSand HighHorsepower = guaranteed OHKO on Mega Gengar. Tyranitar Crunch into Mega Gengar 83-162% (roll). Mega Gengar ShadowBall into Gholdengo 90-123% (can OHKO) - don't leave Gholdengo raw vs it without Nasty Plot/support.
Altaria has Cloud Nine: it turns off sand and neuters Sand Rush; prioritize KOing Altaria with Fairy moves (Floette Moonblast/DazzlingGleam) whenever it's on field.
Grimmsnarl: Prankster FakeOut/Reflect/LightScreen/PartingShot - screens blunt my physical core; Gholdengo ignores PartingShot (GoodAsGold), Floette resists Dark.
Gliscor Earthquake is 2x on Tyranitar, 1x on Excadrill; Rotom-Heat/Floette are Ground-immune/neutral options.
Primarina HyperVoice is Water via LiquidVoice (2x on Excadrill/Tyranitar); Gholdengo and Sinistcha wall it.
Game 2+: consider Sinistcha RagePowder to shield Excadrill from FakeOut/Close Combat, or Rotom-Heat if they lean Ground/physical.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Altaria)
decisions.rationale: Prankster Light Screen (+1) before Floette; Clay 8T halves Moonblast/DG/Ice Beam OHKO ranges. Tailwind sets speed for Mega Gengar/Prim. Cloud Nine already blanks sand. Fake Out less needed once Screen is up; Reflect next for Excadrill.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: Opp sand (Ttar+Excadrill SoftSand), Mega Floette, Gholdengo LO, Rotom-H Charcoal, Sinistcha Hospitality. Cloud Nine Altaria blanks Sand Rush/chip + TW/WoW. Mega Gengar Shadow Tag deletes Ttar/Floette/Gholdengo after Grimm Clay screens+FO. Primarina LO Liquid Voice HV/Moonblast. Bring Grimm/Altaria/Gengar/Prim. Prioritize Screen then Reflect; Mega Gengar after screens; TW enables revenge. Chople Ttar; avoid EQ into Rotom.

decisions.rationale: Bring Mega Gengar now under LS+TW to Shadow Tag and pressure Ttar/Floette; Grimm can FO/Reflect next. Primarina later for HV.

Mega Floette (Speed ~137 > Altaria max 132) with Fairy Aura Moonblast should OHKO Altaria, removing Cloud Nine (restoring sand/Sand Rush) and denying Tailwind. Tyranitar Rock Slide chips Grimmsnarl 27-53% while adding 46-84% insurance on Altaria if Fake Out flinches Floette, plus double flinch chances. Ice Beam alone can't KO Altaria; Crunch is 0.25x on Grimmsnarl.

TTar IceBeam Altaria 50-91% (no OHKO); TTar RockSlide Altaria 46-85%, Grimmsnarl 27-53%; TTar IceBeam Grimmsnarl only 13-24%. Floette Moonblast Grimmsnarl 76-139% pre-aura (aura makes it a near-certain OHKO).
Foe threats: Mega Gengar (ShadowTag, 165-200 Spe) outspeeds all but sand Excadrill (260); Excadrill HighHorsepower OHKOs it; TTar Crunch 83-162%. Mega Gengar ShadowBall can OHKO Gholdengo.
Altaria Cloud Nine disables sand - always prioritize KOing it with Fairy moves.
Grimmsnarl Prankster FakeOut/screens/PartingShot; Gholdengo ignores PartingShot; Floette resists Dark.
Gliscor EQ 2x on TTar; Primarina HyperVoice is Water (2x on Excadrill/TTar), walled by Gholdengo/Sinistcha.
Game 2+: consider Sinistcha RagePowder to shield Excadrill, or Rotom-Heat vs Ground/physical leads.

decisions.rationale: Reflect (Prankster) softens Ttar Crunch/RS into Gengar. Mega+FB Ttar: Chople halves but chunks hard/consumes berry; Shadow Tag locks both. TW Gengar outspeeds; LS already cuts Floette. Grimm may fall to MB but Gengar lives to clean.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: Opp sand (Ttar+Excadrill SoftSand), Mega Floette Fairy Aura, Gholdengo LO, Rotom-H Charcoal, Sinistcha Hospitality. Cloud Nine Altaria blanks Sand Rush/chip + TW/WoW. Mega Gengar Shadow Tag deletes Ttar/Floette/Gholdengo after Grimm Clay screens+FO. Primarina LO Liquid Voice HV/Moonblast. Bring Grimm/Altaria/Gengar/Prim. Prioritize Screen then Reflect; Mega Gengar after screens; TW enables revenge. Chople Ttar (FB not full OHKO); avoid EQ into Rotom. Sand timer independent of Ttar faint.

decisions.rationale: Only Primarina remains; send into slot a vs Ttar (Moonblast SE, Water HV 2x Rock). Screens+TW still up. Pass empty slot b. Game likely lost but force damage.

Grimmsnarl can't Fake Out again, so both my moves land. Floette Moonblast (Fairy Aura) into Grimmsnarl at 59% is a likely KO even through Light Screen; Tyranitar Crunch is 83-161% on Mega Gengar (Light Screen doesn't reduce physical), a strong chance to remove the Shadow Tag threat immediately. Chople Berry lets Tyranitar likely survive a 70%-accuracy Focus Blast. Splitting targets threatens a double KO rather than overkilling one.

decisions.rationale: TW Prim outspeeds both. Fairy Aura + LO Moonblast OHKOes Ttar (Chople irrelevant); removes Rock Slide/Crunch pressure under screens. HV Water chips both but weaker single KO; Floette lives any hit.

Fairy Aura boosts our Moonblast.

decisions.rationale: Primarina is their last Pokémon; three foes are already down. Rock Slide (single target, no spread cut) plus aura-boosted Moonblast stack ~44-80% through Reflect/Light Screen, plus sand chip, setting up a clean KO next turn. Crunch/Ice Beam are resisted; switching only invites Liquid Voice Hyper Voice (Water) damage on a 4x-weak Excadrill. Tyranitar survives Water Hyper Voice comfortably, so no need to pivot.

decisions.rationale: Opponent has only Primarina left (42%). Excadrill takes 4x from Liquid Voice Hyper Voice (Water) and would be at risk; Gholdengo resists Fairy and Ice, takes Water neutrally, and Good as Gold blocks status. Gholdengo + Floette can then double into Primarina next turn for the win, with Protect available if needed.

decisions.rationale: Moonblast Floette for Fairy Aura-boosted damage under LO; screens blunt return. HV useless vs Gholdengo immunity; Ice Beam weak into both. Tailwind ends soon; chip Floette now.

Primarina is the opponent's last Pokemon at 42%. Make It Rain through Light Screen deals ~29-50% and Fairy-Aura Moonblast ~26-45% (observed 42% last turn), so the pair is a guaranteed KO and wins the game. Gholdengo is immune/resistant to Primarina's options anyway, so no defensive hedging is needed; only a Protect saves it, and Tailwind expires this turn so I win next turn regardless.

reflections.summary: Lost due to flawed preview bring/lead: Altaria (Cloud Nine) into Ttar+Mega Floette died turn 1 to SE Moonblast+Rock Slide before Tailwind value, then Mega Gengar missed FB on Chople Ttar and fell to Crunch, leaving Primarina 1v2 vs Floette+Gholdengo.
reflections.adjustment: Drop or bench Altaria vs this lead; bring/lead Grimm+Primarina (or Gengar) instead, set both screens first, and treat Chople Ttar as requiring chip/status before FB rather than a clean Shadow Tag delete.
reflections.notebook: Opp sand (Ttar Adamant Chople RockSlide/Crunch/IceBeam/Protect + Excadrill SoftSand SandRush); Mega Floette Modest FairyAura (Moonblast spam/DazzlingGleam/Psychic/Protect); Gholdengo Modest LO GoodasGold (MakeItRain/NastyPlot/ShadowBall/Protect, midgame switch-in); Rotom-H Charcoal; Sinistcha Hospitality Sitrus. Leads Ttar+Mega Floette and pressures immediately. Sand persists post-Ttar. Fairy Aura also boosts our Moonblast. Prior plan Altaria lead fails hard into that core—avoid; Grimm Clay screens still core but Gengar FB unreliable (miss+Chople); Primarina LO better cleaner. Next: different four/lead order, chip Ttar first.

reflections.summary: Won a 4-turn sweep because the preview read was correct: their lead was a pure support core (Grimmsnarl screens + Altaria Tailwind/Cloud Nine) that spent every turn on setup while I applied immediate KO pressure. Mega Floette was the right Mega choice — Fairy Aura Moonblast OHKO'd Altaria and one-shot Grimmsnarl through Reflect — and Tyranitar's physical Crunch removed Mega Gengar despite Light Screen (Gengar also whiffed Focus Blast, which would only have been a 2HKO through Chople anyway).
